mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${req.layer} WHERE deleted = 0
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.keyword}, '%')

SELECT r.device_id AS id, d.name AS name, d.device_code AS code, d.device_type_code AS type, CASE WHEN r.state IN (1, 3) THEN 'online' WHEN r.state = 2 THEN 'offline' ELSE 'fault' END AS status, r.longitude AS longitude, r.latitude AS latitude, ST_Distance( ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{req.lon}, #{req.lat}), 4326)::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(r.longitude, r.latitude), 4326)::geography ) AS distance, b.name AS building, f.name AS floor, a.name AS room, p.product_name AS productName, r.online_time AS lastOnlineTime, d.create_time AS createTime FROM ibms_device_runtime r JOIN ibms_device d ON d.id = r.device_id LEFT JOIN area a ON a.id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN floor f ON f.id = r.floor_id LEFT JOIN building b ON b.id = r.building_id LEFT JOIN ibms_product p ON p.id = d.ibms_product_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND ST_DWithin( ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(#{req.lon}, #{req.lat}), 4326)::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(r.longitude, r.latitude), 4326)::geography, #{req.radius} ) ORDER BY distance LIMIT #{req.limit}

SELECT r.device_id AS id, d.name AS name, d.device_code AS code, d.device_type_code AS type, CASE WHEN r.state IN (1, 3) THEN 'online' WHEN r.state = 2 THEN 'offline' ELSE 'fault' END AS status, r.longitude AS longitude, r.latitude AS latitude, b.name AS building, f.name AS floor, a.name AS room, p.product_name AS productName, r.online_time AS lastOnlineTime, d.create_time AS createTime FROM ibms_device_runtime r JOIN ibms_device d ON d.id = r.device_id LEFT JOIN area a ON a.id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN floor f ON f.id = r.floor_id LEFT JOIN building b ON b.id = r.building_id LEFT JOIN ibms_product p ON p.id = d.ibms_product_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.longitude BETWEEN #{req.minLon} AND #{req.maxLon} AND r.latitude BETWEEN #{req.minLat} AND #{req.maxLat}
AND ( CASE WHEN r.state IN (1, 3) THEN 'online' WHEN r.state = 2 THEN 'offline' ELSE 'fault' END ) = #{req.status}

SELECT r.device_id AS deviceId, d.name AS deviceName, r.longitude AS longitude, r.latitude AS latitude, NULL::numeric AS altitude, r.address AS address, c.id AS campusId, c.name AS campusName, b.id AS buildingId, b.name AS buildingName, f.id AS floorId, f.name AS floorName, a.id AS roomId, a.name AS roomName FROM ibms_device_runtime r JOIN ibms_device d ON d.id = r.device_id LEFT JOIN campus c ON c.id = r.campus_id LEFT JOIN building b ON b.id = r.building_id LEFT JOIN floor f ON f.id = r.floor_id LEFT JOIN area a ON a.id = r.room_id WHERE r.device_id = #{deviceId} AND r.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ibms_device_runtime SET longitude = #{req.lon}, latitude = #{req.lat}, updater = #{req.updater}, update_time = NOW() WHERE device_id = #{req.deviceId} AND deleted = 0
